- Success criteria & next steps (MAP)

I put together a short scheduling matrix (attached) with a "mutex" availability approach to avoid back-and-forth. Please pick one time that works for all stakeholders or propose an immediate alternative:

Option A — Wed, Oct 28 — 10:00–10:30 PT (your infra + product manager)
Option B — Thu, Oct 29 — 14:00–14:30 PT (engineering lead + data privacy owner)
Option C — Fri, Oct 30 — 09:00–09:30 PT (exec + infra)

If none of these fit, tell me two 30‑min slots next week and I’ll convert to a calendar hold. Attached: discovery-notes.pdf, scheduling-matrix.xlsx, and a draft 30min agenda.

Ben / Neha — looping you in to help run the technical deep dive if Marcus/Jane pick Option B.

Thanks,
